Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. Note: Kindly upload the documents such as MSME, MII, or any relevant documents in the designated plac es to avoid ambiguity. Delivery schedule: As per tender specification terms. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: 1. The firm should have supplied at least three items as per the above list of ite ms in last 5 Years. 2. A minimum of 3 purchase orders should be enclosed in proof of above. 3. Midhani has the right to reject the offer based on the feedback given by the engineers after the trial. Travel expenses for Midhani engineers will be b orne by Midhani. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: 1. Trial will be conducted on delivered material within one week of receipt of ma terial. If the items are not giving satisfactory performance, then the correspondi ng items will be rejected. .
